# Boston.gov

> The official digital hub for City of Boston government services, civic engagement, and resident resources.

Boston.gov provides comprehensive access to municipal services, permits, elections, parks, and community information for Boston residents and visitors. The site integrates multiple city departments and offers 24/7 support through Boston 311 for non-emergency service requests.

## Key Topics

- Boston 311
- City Services
- Permits and Licenses
- Civic Engagement
- Elections and Voting
- Parks and Recreation
- City Council
- Economic Opportunity
- Historic Preservation
- Resident Resources
- Service Requests
- Government Transparency
- Community Events
- Boston Property Information

## Core Government Services

- [Homepage](https://www.boston.gov): Official City of Boston homepage with access to city services and resources
- [Boston 311](https://www.boston.gov/departments/boston-311): 24/7 constituent service center for non-emergency reporting and service requests
- [City Council](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-council): Legislative body information with councilor contacts and municipal legislation details
- [City Clerk](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk): City Clerk services for licenses, permits, records, and municipal documentation

## Civic Engagement & Elections

- [Election](https://www.boston.gov/departments/election): Voter registration, election information, and polling location details for Boston
- [Events](https://www.boston.gov/events): Community events calendar featuring public events and cultural activities in Boston
- [Newsletter Subscription](https://newsletters.boston.gov/subscribe): Newsletter subscription management for City of Boston updates and services

## Economic Development & Planning

- [Economic Opportunity and Inclusion](https://www.boston.gov/government/cabinets/economic-opportunity-and-inclusion): Cabinet page for economic development, small business support, and funding programs

## Parks, Recreation & Historic Preservation

- [Playgrounds and Parks in Boston](https://www.boston.gov/departments/parks-and-recreation/playgrounds-and-parks-boston): Directory of Boston parks, playgrounds, and outdoor recreation facilities
- [Landmarks Commission](https://www.boston.gov/departments/landmarks-commission): Historic preservation office managing landmarks, design review, and archaeology

## Resident Resources & Guides

- [Guides](https://www.boston.gov/guides): Directory of civic guides covering housing, transportation, and community services
